## Success Criteria

### Approval Gate (≥15%)

```
✅ PASS: Average improvement ≥15%
   → Proceed to Phase 4 full rollout (20 skills)
   → Deploy optimized instructions to production

⚠️ CAUTION: 2% ≤ improvement < 15%
   → Refine rubrics based on feedback
   → Re-run full pilot with updates
   → Conditional approval

❌ FAIL: Improvement < 2%
   → Pivot to alternative (expert review, fine-tuning)
   → Re-assess optimization approach
```

## Key Features (Tier 2 vs. Tier 1)

| Feature | Tier 1 | Tier 2 |
|---------|--------|--------|
| Metric Type | Binary (pass/fail) | Continuous (0-1 semantic) |
| Granularity | 5-15 tests | Same tests + semantic depth |
| Eval Method | Discrete tests | RAGAS + Rubric consensus |
| Signal Strength | +1.02% → -0.48% | Target ≥15% |
| Root Cause | Coarse scoring | **SOLVED**: Semantic metrics |
